after hours answering service.title: Answering & after-hours dispatch for contractors
after hours answering service.why: The video's 'call centers' idea, done properly. Clicks for answering-service searches cost $57-71 (Semrush), and 'after hours answering service' has a ranking difficulty of just 11. In Chicago the map leaders have 1, 1 and 15 reviews ('answering service') and 5, 9 and 1 ('call center'). Each client pays monthly, so one sale is worth years of revenue.
after hours answering service.model: 6 Central Answer & Dispatch: serve TJ's Nationwide Roadside first, then sell after-hours call handling and dispatch to plumbers, HVAC, towing and restoration companies. Win it through the website, ranking in Google's regular search results and ads; add a Google Business Profile only once there is a staffed office that clients can visit.
after hours answering service.license: TCPA and the Telemarketing Sales Rule if you ever make outbound calls; HIPAA if you answer for medical offices. Google won't list an online-only business.
after hours answering service.next: Write the offer (hours covered, price per month, per-minute overage), stand up the phone system on TJ's dispatch, and sign 3 pilot contractors from the partner lists.

personal trainer.title: In-home personal training (Chicago)
personal trainer.why: Demand doubled: 'personal trainer near me' is about 201,000 searches/mo now vs about 110,000 a year ago (OpenRush). In Chicago the map pack median is 41 reviews, and the in-home trainers who show up have no reviews at all.
personal trainer.model: An in-home and mobile training brand with certified trainers on staff or contract, sold as monthly packages. Recurring revenue, no license needed, and it runs from home.
personal trainer.license: Trainer certification (NASM, ACE or similar) and liability insurance.
personal trainer.next: Recruit 2-3 certified trainers, set package pricing, and launch a service-area profile from a real base.

boat shrink wrap.title: Mobile boat winterization & shrink wrap (Chicago, this month)
boat shrink wrap.why: Ranking difficulty is 7-8 and the season is now (searches peak October-November). The top Chicago shrink-wrap listings have 63, 3 and 3 reviews.
boat shrink wrap.model: One mobile crew and van: winterize and shrink-wrap in the fall, de-winterize in spring, mobile boat detailing in summer (an extension of the car-detailing project).
boat shrink wrap.license: Insurance, heat-gun safety, and marina permission to work on site. No Illinois license found for mobile winterization; confirm.
boat shrink wrap.next: If a qualified marine tech is available this month, take fall bookings now. Otherwise build the profile and reviews over the winter for the spring de-winterize season.

carports.title: Carports & metal buildings (Dallas, not Chicago)
carports.why: The Dallas map pack is wide open (11, 1 and 4 reviews, and one listing named 'carports dallas tx', a rank-and-rent listing at risk of suspension). Chicago is locked (median 322). Texas has no state GC license.
carports.model: Partner & manage with a dealer-installer, or a 6 Central install crew in Texas.
carports.next: Run qualify-partners on Dallas carport installers, and check Houston and San Antonio next.

room additions.title: Room additions (Chicago & Dallas)
room additions.why: Ranking difficulty is 3 and clicks cost $10-17.56. The map packs are open in both cities: Chicago median 30, Dallas 23 (16, 23, 43).
room additions.model: Partner & manage with licensed general contractors. This plugs straight into the decks & general contracting standing watch.
room additions.license: Chicago GC license and permits; Dallas contractor registration.
room additions.next: Add room additions to the GC partner search when we run qualify-partners for Chicago contractors.

mobile hair stylist.title: Mobile hair, barber & spray tan (Chicago)
mobile hair stylist.why: The Chicago packs are thin: mobile hair stylist median 7, mobile barber 30, mobile spray tan 34. Clients rebook every few weeks.
mobile hair stylist.model: Partner & manage with licensed stylists and barbers who already go mobile, or a mobile-beauty brand with licensed staff.
mobile hair stylist.license: Illinois barber or cosmetology license for hair. Confirm the rules for spray tan.
mobile hair stylist.next: Shortlist licensed mobile stylists and barbers in Chicago with thin profiles.

homeschool program.title: Homeschool enrichment programs
homeschool program.why: The Chicago map pack is nearly empty (4, 11 and 5 reviews), and OpenRush shows $22.93 clicks. Demand is steady at 2,400-4,400/mo.
homeschool program.model: A real enrichment program (classes and co-op days) with qualified instructors, or Partner & manage with local co-ops.
homeschool program.license: Background checks; confirm facility and insurance rules.
homeschool program.next: Watch list for now. It needs educators, and it's further from the home-services core.

apostille services.title: Apostille & document services (Chicago)
apostille services.why: The Chicago map pack is nearly empty (3, 2 and 51 reviews) on 2,400 searches/mo nationally. People need foreign-use documents authenticated and don't know the steps.
apostille services.model: A document-services desk: prepare, notarize (with a commissioned notary) and courier documents to the Illinois Secretary of State for apostilles. It can share staff with the answering service.
apostille services.license: An Illinois notary commission for anyone notarizing. Apostilles themselves are issued by the Secretary of State; the business only prepares and submits. Confirm the agent rules.
apostille services.next: Price a standard apostille package, confirm Secretary of State turnaround times, and test with a landing page plus a profile at a real office.

tv mounting.title: TV mounting & furniture assembly
tv mounting.why: Steady demand (5,400 and 3,600/mo), $4.45-5.20 clicks, and a home-based, low-risk operation. Chicago packs are beatable but not empty (medians 90 for both).
tv mounting.model: One install crew under the existing 'repair and install' project. Bundles well with smart-home and home-theater jobs.
tv mounting.license: Low-voltage only; no electrical work without a licensed electrician. Liability insurance.
tv mounting.next: Add to the repair-and-install offer and collect reviews from the first 20 jobs.
